payload.content:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Artifact smoke test</title>
<style>
  body { margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 16px system-ui; background: #0b1020; color: #eef2ff; }
  button { border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; background: #7c3aed; color: white; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
<button id="demo">Interactive artifact ready</button>
<script>document.querySelector('#demo').onclick = (event) => { event.currentTarget.textContent = 'Interaction works'; };</script>
</html>
